title: Erdős–Rényi graph distribution
statement: For a natural number $v$ and $p\in[0,1]$, assign each possible edge on $\{0,1,\ldots,v-1\}$ an independent Boolean value, each with the biased Boolean probability mass function at parameter $p$. The resulting probability mass function on encoded graphs is the Erdős–Rényi graph distribution.
